image_description: A side-profile view of a Red Lionfish (Pterois volitans) swimming in an aquarium environment. The fish displays characteristic vertical reddish-brown and white stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with spotted membranes, and prominent dorsal spines. The background consists of blurred rocks and gravel substrate.
